استشبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَشَبُّوا (istašabbū) /is.ta.ʃab.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# اُسْتُشِبُّوا (ustušibbū) /us.tu.ʃib.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# اِسْتَشِبُّوا (istašibbū) /is.ta.ʃib.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
